import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';
import * as ui from '../support/ui';

test.setTimeout(240_000);
test.describe("person timeline", () => {
  test("person timeline", { tag: '@functionality' }, async ({ browser }) => {
    const sheet = ui.sheetId();
    const pg_uma = await ui.userPage(browser, "uma", sheet);
    await ui.setToday(pg_uma, "2026-03-10");
    expect(await ui.setRate(pg_uma, {"grade": "A", "pct": "10.00"})).toBe(true);
    const p_ada = ui.must(await ui.addPerson(pg_uma, {"name": "Ada", "grade": "A"}));
    const c_ada_0 = ui.must(await ui.addClaim(pg_uma, p_ada, {"amount": "10.00", "date": "2026-03-01"}));
    const c_ada_1 = ui.must(await ui.addClaim(pg_uma, p_ada, {"amount": "20.00", "date": "2026-03-05"}));
    expect(await ui.claimAction(pg_uma, c_ada_0, "open")).toBe(true);
    const pg_vic = await ui.userPage(browser, "vic", sheet);
    expect(await ui.claimAction(pg_vic, c_ada_0, "settle")).toBe(true);
    await ui.refresh(pg_uma);
    expect(await ui.editPerson(pg_uma, p_ada, {"grade": "B", "gradeFrom": "2026-03-05"})).toBe(true);
    expect(await ui.hold(pg_uma, p_ada, {"from": "2026-03-02", "to": "2026-03-04"})).toBe(true);
    expect(await ui.retire(pg_uma, p_ada, "2026-03-08")).toBe(true);
    await ui.showRetired(pg_uma, true);
    await ui.refresh(pg_uma);
    await expect(pg_uma.getByTestId("person-row-" + p_ada).getByTestId("person-timeline-line")).toHaveText(["2026-03-01 claim 10.00 SETTLED", "2026-03-02 hold to 2026-03-04", "2026-03-05 grade B", "2026-03-05 claim 20.00 DRAFT", "2026-03-08 retired"]);
    await ui.setToday(pg_uma, "2026-03-12");
    expect(await ui.unretire(pg_uma, p_ada)).toBe(true);
    expect(await ui.hold(pg_uma, p_ada, {"from": "2026-03-05"})).toBe(true);
    await ui.refresh(pg_uma);
    await expect(pg_uma.getByTestId("person-row-" + p_ada).getByTestId("person-timeline-line")).toHaveText(["2026-03-01 claim 10.00 SETTLED", "2026-03-02 hold to 2026-03-04", "2026-03-05 grade B", "2026-03-05 claim 20.00 DRAFT", "2026-03-05 hold", "2026-03-08 retired", "2026-03-12 unretired"]);
    await ui.expectAudit(sheet, [
      `RATE_SET sheet=${sheet} by=uma grade=A rate=10.00`,
      `PERSON_ADDED sheet=${sheet} by=uma name=Ada grade=A`,
      `ROLLUP sheet=${sheet} by=uma person=Ada claimed=0.00 due-total=0.00 overdue-total=0.00`,
      `CLAIM_ADDED sheet=${sheet} by=uma person=Ada amount=10.00 date=2026-03-01`,
      `CLAIM_ADDED sheet=${sheet} by=uma person=Ada amount=20.00 date=2026-03-05`,
      `CLAIM_OPENED sheet=${sheet} by=uma person=Ada amount=10.00 date=2026-03-01`,
      `ROLLUP sheet=${sheet} by=uma person=Ada claimed=10.00 due-total=1.00 overdue-total=0.00`,
      `TOTALS sheet=${sheet} by=uma claimed-total=10.00 due-total=1.00 overdue-total=0.00`,
      `CLAIM_SETTLED sheet=${sheet} by=vic person=Ada amount=10.00 date=2026-03-01 number=FY2026-1 due=1.00`,
      `PERSON_EDITED sheet=${sheet} by=uma name=Ada grade=B`,

      `PERSON_UNRETIRED sheet=${sheet} by=uma name=Ada on=2026-03-12`,

    ]);

set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."

  echo "bin/e2e: something is already serving on port ${PORT}; stop it (bin/stop) or set PORT to a free port" >&2
  exit 2

bin/start
cleanup() { bin/stop || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT

ready=0

  sleep 1
done

  echo "bin/e2e: the app did not become healthy on port ${PORT} within 300s; see .run/app.log" >&2
  exit 2
fi

( cd e2e && npm ci --silent && npx --yes playwright install chromium && npx playwright test )
